capability: switching (context switch of the motor law: pull <-> push)

flip_family.keys: catch_speck_l4 + 50% unflipped / 25% flipped from t0 / 25% t_flip ~ U[256, 768] (the prior V4 family)
flip_family.hand_tissue: V4 'switch watchdog' -3.02 +- 0.24 on this family (latched in 90% of unflipped lives); best hand body annulus-norm -0.23 (no switching)

flip_from0.keys: catch_speck_l4 + t_flip = 2^-20 in every life (push law from t0)
flip_from0.hand_tissue: V4 annulus-flip (a FIXED inner-rim pathway, no switching) +5.61 +- 0.17 in from-t0 lives; 'switch forced' (hidden-plane latch forced on) +3.25 +- 0.14

table.switching_component_note: 0 by construction: the world rule says every life is flipped from t0, so SW1 starts latched on the push law and never detects anything (SW2 = SW1). SW1 - SW0 (= law KNOWLEDGE, a fixed rule a mirrored reflex also has) is reported as law_knowledge.

flip_mid.keys: catch_speck_l4 (d0 1, d_min 0.5) + scratch slot t_flip ~ U[256, 768] per life (one-way pull -> push at t_flip); harness WORLDS['flip_mid']
flip_mid.hand_tissue: V4 'switch watchdog' in midlife lives -1.00 +- 0.30 vs best reflex (128 lives); 'switch forced' -3.62 +- 0.26; annulus-flip -2.54 +- 0.28; best hand body of any kind = annulus-norm (no switching, F 3.46 vs reflex 3.57). Oracle switch bound over annulus-norm +2.67 (mid lives)

flip_mix.keys: catch_speck_l4 + per-life 50/50 draw ('flipmix' from the life seed): unflipped, or t_flip ~ U[256, 768] (the flip_mid draw)
flip_mix.hand_tissue: not measured on this mixture. V4 'switch watchdog': -6.84 +- 0.29 in unflipped lives (latched in 90%), -1.00 +- 0.30 in midlife lives, so about -3.9 on a 50/50 none/mid mixture (estimate, unpaired)

verdict_rule: ADMIT: info gap (SW1 detect @fp - best reflex) > 3 SE and >= 1 F, AND switching component (SW1 - SW0, the same tracker with its flip detector disabled) > 3 SE, AND do-less gap clearly smaller (do-less mean + 3 SE < info mean - 3 SE). NO_HEADROOM: the info gap is bounded below 1 F (mean + 3 SE < 1), or the switching component is absent by construction or bounded below 1 F (mean + 3 SE < 1). UNCLEAR: anything else.
